notes.title: BI:C v1.4 Steam Changelog
notes.content:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Five new exciting units are coming soon!
[*] Added a new Theater: Central Europe!
[*] We have changed the current Flame Tank to be an all new, more versatile Flame Tank! Now with a rotating turret to take out those pesky swarming infantry units!
[*] Developer’s commentary: The vehicle we used in the past had a fixed projector for the flame. For balance reasons we decided it was better to swap it out for a tank with a rotating turret.
[*] We have improved the Alliance interface! Navigating through will now be easier than ever before!
[*] We have expanded the training opportunities by adding more trainers to battle!
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that was showing that the Panjandrum would aggro all enemies on the battlefield
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing an error pop-up to show when there was no error
[*] (Localization) Fixed a number of missing characters in all languages
[*] (Localization) Fixed multiple localization issues around unit and theater names, they should now fit better in the interface
[*] (Localization) All value separators are now consistent in all languages
[*] Fixed missing settings when opening the game for the first time
[*] Fixed minor visual bugs on the Warship during battle
[*] Fixed a bug that was stopping interaction with scrollbars in specific circumstances
[*] Fixed experience rewards when promoting a unit to max rank to be showing as expected
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing the promote arrow to display blue instead of red for max rank units
[*] Fixed visual bugs related to the medal icon used in certain pop-ups
[*] Fixed the loading animation to not overlap with text on the name yourself pop-up and alliance creation pop-up
[*] Fixed mines doing damage during their set up time if destroyed
[/list]
[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved the Flame Tank to the Western Front theater
[*] Moved the Tracked Mine to the Western Front theater
[*] Moved the Fighter Squadron to the Western Front theater
[*] In preparation of future units we rebalanced the Health of all the Air Support
[*] And an exciting new mechanic coming soon!
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] General improvements on game stability
[*] Adjusted the minimum medals required to be promoted to a new theater since the addition of Central Europe. If you are above the minimum requirement you will be promoted once you restart the game
[*] Improved clarity on stat display in the unit info screen
[*] Added more loading tips at the start of the game
[*] Added health to the stat display of Air Support in unit info
[*] Removed the debuff range indicator on Barbed Wire and Tank Trap
[*] Player experience points show when at max level
[/list]

notes.title: Battle Islands: Commanders v1.3.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
BIC v1.3.4 Changelog

Welcome to our latest major update! Commanders is now available to play on both iOS and Android! With this new release also comes a series of improvements and changes for our loyal players across Steam, PS4 and Xbox One!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Commanders is now released on iOS and Android!
[*]Chinese traditional and simplified is now available on both PS4 and Xbox One!
[*]Many additional training improvements for new recruits!
[*]Fighter and Fighter Squadron have been reworked and improved! More details in the balance changes below
[*]Significantly improved the performance of the game on all platforms!
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an extremely rare bug where units affected by Smoke would have the rate of fire permanently slowed for the remainder of the battle
[*]Fixed a minor visual bug that would show units of other players to be promotable when inspecting other players’ profiles
[*]Fixed bent knees of a riflemen in the Howitzer, Rifleman Squad and Riflemen in the units tab and also fixed the Mortarman’s foot. Our best orthopedic surgeons were hard at work to help the soldiers!
[*]Fixed an issue where the Medium Tank could occasionally fire further than intended
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Minesweeper to not turn around to attack its target
[*]Fixed Air Support being affected by the Officer buff and Barbed Wire debuff in rare circumstances
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Alliance settings to occasionally not save changes
[*]Fixed a visual flicker when loading the Alliance tab
[*]Fixed Fortify snap so it is easier to deploy on emplacements
[*]Fixed a bug where the sounds did not always stop at the end of a battle
[*]Fixed a rare bug that could cause some alliances in the leaderboard to be in the incorrect order
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing units played to briefly show the default color instead of the alliance colour
[*]Fixed an issue with Smoke sound loop and it would not stop after a battle ended
[*]Fixed Paratroopers standing on the edge of the battlefield where there was no ground for them to stand on
[*]Fixed the unit death effect so they disappear correctly
[*]Fixed minor visual bugs when matched with another player and when a match ended
[*]Fixed multiple text overflows and overlaps in Russian, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish
[/list]

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]We reworked and rebalanced both the Fighter and Fighter Squadron:
[list]
[*]The Fighter now has a single AoE so it can hit each target only once but the damage has been increased to compensate for this change
[*]The Fighter Squadron now has 3 planes, fires in 3 AoEs and can hit each target only once just like the Fighter
[/list][/list]
[list]
[*]Moved the Officer to the Central Pacific from the Boot Camp
[list]
[*]Developers’ Notes: We believe that the Officer, while being a very interesting and powerful card in later stages of the game, should not be part of the starting epic pool for new players, as it offers less raw power than the Tank Destroyer or the Rifleman Squad. For this reason we have moved it to the Central Pacific theater.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]During battle, units can now be dragged from their card and dropped onto the battlefield
[*]Surplus units are now converted into supplies when they are obtained at max rank and maximum storage
[*]Added an options menu during battle!
[*]Added a delay on the confirmation for spending gold when promoting or buying units
[*]Added a new VFX on the ranked battle button
[*]Added new messages during the login process to explain what the game is doing at each step
[*]Changed the sound played when you adjust the SFX volume in the options
[*]Changed the taunts to have a white backing to improve readability
[*]Changed the size of most buttons in the UI to be of matching sizes
[*]Changed how we display the speed controls in replays to be more intuitive
[*]Improved the grey out of units in the Units tab for locked units
[*]Improved the visual display of the “Next” unit in battle
[*]Improved the VFX for units that are not yet ready to play in battle
[*]Improved the VFX for when crates are available to be collected
[*]Sgt. John Howe is now correctly a decorated commando and proudly shows his medals in Training battles!
[*]Alliance and player information now updates faster
[*]The replay controls and retreat button are now found on the left hand side of the screen
[*]Moved all the buttons that were in the control banner to the main UI
[*]Added “+” icons near gold and supplies to quickly go to the store
[*]When switching from controller to mouse the cursor will reappear by moving the mouse instead of only when clicking 
[*]Improved the localization for “unlocking” crates. “Opening” is now used only when the crate is unlocked and ready
[*]Reworded some messages so they make more sense
[*]Improved the wording of “Taunt” in Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Improved the wording of “Crate” In Brazilian Portuguese
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]AP mine shows 0 damage in unit information. We are aware of this issue and it will be fixed in a future patch
[*]After watching a new unit demonstration, the music will change to the battle music and not go back to the main menu music. This will be fixed in a future patch
[/list]

notes.title: Battle Islands: Commanders v1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders!

Welcome to BIC v1.2, our first major update! With this update we decided to expand our supported language to welcome all the Commanders from China.  We have tackled many frustrating bugs reported by our fantastic community and at the same time we overhauled the initial training with Sgt. Howe. Phew!!

So without further ado, here is the v1.2 Changelog:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Simplified and Traditional Chinese localization
[*]Completely overhauled the initial training for new players! Commanders will now have a much smoother and informative introduction from Sgt. Howe
[*]Brand new unit information briefing! When you unlock a new unit you will see an example of special abilities and a brief explanation of its behavior
[*]Added theater promotion pop-up for whenever you earn enough medals to reach the next theater
[*]Added a new “Coming Soon” section to the units tab
[*]Improved the trainer's tactics during battle
[*]Added the new Ration Crate with a speedy 15-minute timer
[/list]
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Trainers being able to play a unit before the battle starts
[*]Fixed various crashes
[*]Fixed various battle synchronization issues
[*]Fixed various small UI bugs
[*]Fixed various small visual effects 
[*]Fixed an error during matchmaking that prevented some players from starting a ranked battle under extremely rare circumstances
[*]Fixed Minesweeper taking damage from mines
[*]Fixed the rewards of certain crates showing incorrectly
[*]Trainers will not look through Camouflage and won’t fire Naval Support on units they should not be able to see :)
[*]Fixed Smoke not debuffing the enemy units under certain circumstances
[*](Localization) Fixed text overlapping in most languages
[*]Fixed mines being visible if another mine exploded near them recently
[*]Fixed unresponsive “Alliance Info” button when opening the alliance in certain circumstances
[*](Steam) Fixed bug that caused the Steam username to not update in game after a restart
[*](Localization) Fixed various small typos in all languages
[*](Localization) Fixed missing strings that were still showing in English in most languages
[*](Controller) Fixed a number of UI sounds that were missing
[*](Controller) Fixed various small navigation issues
[*](Controller) Fixed leave/disband being bound on the wrong button
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Smoke cost reduced to 3 (from 4).
[*]Smoke debuff increased to 50% (from 40%)
[*]Smoke duration reduced to 8 seconds (from 10)
[*]Smoke radius decreased to 3 (from 4)
[*]Minesweeper health increased to 750 (from 700)
[*]Barracks cost reduced to 5 (from 6)
[*]AT Mine radius of explosion decreased to 0.75 (from 1)
[*]AP Mine damage increased to 100 (from 70)
[*]Attack Dogs range of attack decreased to 0.75 (from 1)
[*]Barbed Wire debuff increased to 60% (from 40%)
[*]Riflemen deploy count increased to 6 (from 5)
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/445720/discussions/0/152392549356160919/]developer blog post[/url] for more details about these changes!

[h1]Additional Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a sound effect when changing the volume sliders so you can preview how loud they are
[*]Added time to taunt at the end of a Ranked or Friendly battle 
[*]Added controller sensitivity slider in the options
[*]Improved accuracy of the rewards shown in the Crate pop-up
[*]Improved default controller sensitivity
[*]Added values for volume sliders and controller sensitivity
[*]Added stats for units being spawned from another unit
[*]Improved other units stats display as they were missing certain stats
[*]Added “shared by” in the alliance chat under shared Replays
[*]Added the name of the alliance’s current leader in the Alliance info
[*]The Warship now clearly reacts when activated
[*]Rewrote all units descriptions to better explain their functionality
[*]Added a CP spent display on top of a unit when deploying it in battle
[*]Added new targeting cursor for Naval Support
[*]Remaining enemy Bunkers explode when their Warship is destroyed
[*]Improved the pre-deploy time in battle
[*]Added information on the rewards gained when donating units in an alliance
[*]Entering taunts during a battle will deselect your currently selected unit
[*](Mouse) Deployment now always shows a preview without having to hold the mouse button down
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]We’re still working to improve localization. Let us know in the Community Forums if you have any feedback and suggestions
[*]We are aware of time synchronization issues on start-up, and we are monitoring the current situation
[*]We are also aware of battle synchronization issues that could result in the awarded medals showing as 0. We have fixed a number of issues related to this and will continue to monitor the situation
[/list]

notes.title: Battle Islands: Commanders v1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Developer’s Commentary:[/h1]

Greetings, Commanders! Thank you very much for your feedback!  Keep them coming!

In this update we decided to do some specific balance changes to improve the early stages of playing according to your feedback.  We swapped the Theaters in which the APC and Tank Destroyer are found.  By moving the Tank Destroyer to the Boot Camp we believe there will be a more direct counter to the APC.

At the same time we did not want the Tank Destroyer to dominate the early stages, so we reduced its range to make it easier to surround once it locks on to a Bunker.

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added new visual effect for when Supply Crates and Reinforcement Crates are ready to be opened and when a player can request a Unit in the Alliance!
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Moved the APC to the Central Pacific Theater
[*]Moved the Tank Destroyer to the Boot Camp Theater
[*]Reduced Tank Destroyer range to 4.5 (from 5)
[*]Reduced Mortarman area of effect radius to 2.5 (from 3)
[*]Increased Mortarman setup time to 1 (from 0.8)
[*]Reduced Rifleman Squad cost to 6 (from 7)[/list]

[h1]Additional: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug when trying to synchronize with the game servers
[*]Improved security based on your feedback
[*]Added XP reward display to Unit promotion
[*]Removed Crate warning from Ranked battles
[*](Mouse) Added context menu when requesting Units so you can now view their Info before requesting
[*]Multiple UI visual improvements
[*]Bug fixes (visual and sound fixes)
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
[list]
[*]We are aware that trying to take a screenshot with F12 will hide the UI.  We have a fix ready, but it will be deployed in next patch. Pressing F12 or left ctrl + F12 again will restore the UI. Apologies for the inconvenience![/list]

notes.content:
[h1]Overview:[/h1]
Battle Islands: Commanders is now in Early Access! This is our first update following closed beta. We would like to thank our awesome closed beta testers for their invaluable help and feedback.

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
•	Added 26 new Trainers to the game! We added Trainers to each of our Battle Theaters to provide an expert Training challenge for players that want to test their skills!
•	New Battle Theater added: East Asia!
•	Redesigned and improved the matchmaking screen for both ranked, 
Training and friendly Alliance battles! 
•	Improved the alliance screens and creation process! 
•	Added a sorting button in the Units screen! It is now possible to sort by “Theater,” “Cost,” and “Rarity”!
•	Improved Replay and Units screens! New context menus added to both screens when using mouse input!

[h1]Balance Changes:[/h1]
•	Increased damage of Gun Turret to 350 (from 330)
•	Commandos health increased to 180 (from 150)
•	Bunker turret rotation speed increased to 120 (from 90)
•	Jeep cost reduced to 4 (from 5)
•	Rebels damage decreased to 25 (from 30)
•	Attack Dogs now spawns one less dog (3 instead of 4)
•	Motorcycles health decreased to 220 (from 250)
•	Motorcycles damage decreased to 50 (from 60)
•	Minimum deploy time of all Infantry units set to 1 second (from 0.5 seconds)
•	Light Tank movement speed increased to 1.2 (from 1)
•	Medium Tank movement speed increased to 1.15 (from 0.75)
•	Medium Tank range increased to 6 (from 5)
•	Heavy Tank movement speed increased to 0.8 (from 0.5)
•	Minesweeper movement speed increase to 1.15 (from 0.75)
•	Mortarman damage increased to 80 (from 60)
•	Gurkhas cost decreased to 6 (from 7)
•	Fortify health increased to 180 (from 140)
•	Garage cost decreased to 7 (from 8)
•	Officer hit speed and movement speed buff now also applies to all land Vehicles
•	Medium Bomber cost decreased to 7 (from 8)
•	Medium Bomber area of effect increased to 2.4 (from 1.9)
•	Sniper range decreased to 7.9 (from 9)
•	Comms Tower Command Points generation decreased to 7 (from 8)
•	Comms Tower health decreased to 350 (from 400)
•	Tank Destroyer range increased to 5 (from 4)
•	Tank Destroyer attack setup time decreased to 0.5 (from 1)
•	Tank Destroyer rotation speed increased to 50 (from 30)
•	Flame Tank rotation speed increased to 60 (from 30)
•	Light Tank health increased to 525 (from 450)
•	Heavy Tank turret rotation speed decreased to 75 (from 90)
•	Flamethrower on death explosion damage reduced to 100 (from 200)

[h1]Additional:[/h1]
•	Bug fixes
•	UI optimizations and visual quality improvements

[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
The following issues are going to be fixed in an upcoming hotfix or patch

•	Non-english languages have some strings not correctly localized and are still using the English string. We are working on a fix and would like to apologize for the inconvenience
